// Generated by scripts/registry/barrels.ts — run `pnpm regen`. Do not edit.
export * from './progress'

import type { ComponentMeta } from '@cascivo/core'

export const meta: ComponentMeta = {
  name: 'Progress',
  description: 'Horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a tracked operation',
  category: 'feedback',
  clientJs: 'none',
  states: ['determinate', 'indeterminate'],
  variants: ['primary', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'error'],
  sizes: ['sm', 'md', 'lg'],
  props: [
    {
      name: 'label',
      nameVisibility: 'invisible',
      description:
        'Alias of `ariaLabel` — the same invisible accessible name under the other spelling. Neither is deprecated.',
      type: 'string',
      required: false,
    },
    {
      name: 'ariaLabel',
      nameVisibility: 'invisible',
      description:
        'Invisible accessible name. The catalog convention; the DOM spelling `aria-label` is accepted as an alias so either guess compiles.',
      type: 'string',
      required: false,
    },
    {
      name: 'aria-label',
      type: 'string',
      required: false,
      description: 'Accessible label when no visible label is present.',
    },
    {
      name: 'aria-describedby',
      type: 'string',
      required: false,
      description: 'Id of an element describing the progress bar.',
    },
    {
      name: 'value',
      type: 'number',
      required: false,
      description: '0–100. Omit for indeterminate state.',
    },
    {
      name: 'variant',
      description:
        'Colour of the fill: `primary` (the accent) or a severity tone — `info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`.',
      type: "'primary' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'",
      required: false,
      default: 'primary',
    },
    {
      name: 'size',
      description: "Visual size of the component (e.g. 'sm', 'md', 'lg').",
      type: "'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'",
      required: false,
      default: 'md',
    },
  ],
  tokens: [
    '--cascivo-color-surface-2',
    '--cascivo-color-primary',
    '--cascivo-color-info',
    '--cascivo-color-success',
    '--cascivo-color-warning',
    '--cascivo-color-error',
    '--cascivo-color-accent',
    '--cascivo-radius-full',
    '--cascivo-ease-out',
  ],
  accessibility: {
    role: 'progressbar',
    wcag: '2.2-AA',
    keyboard: [],
    reducedMotion: true,
  },
  examples: [
    { title: 'Determinate', code: '<Progress value={65} />' },
    { title: 'Indeterminate', code: '<Progress aria-label="Loading…" />' },
    { title: 'Success variant', code: '<Progress value={100} variant="success" />' },
    { title: 'Small', code: '<Progress value={40} size="sm" />' },
  ],
  dependencies: [],
  tags: ['progress', 'loading', 'upload', 'bar'],
  intent: {
    whenToUse: [
      'Tracked operations with a known total (file uploads, multi-step imports)',
      'Showing completion percentage of a long-running task',
    ],
    whenNotToUse: [
      'Unbounded waits of unknown duration — use Spinner',
      "Single-action button loading state — use the button's own loading prop",
    ],
    antiPatterns: [
      {
        bad: '<Progress />',
        good: '<Progress aria-label="Uploading file…" />',
        why: 'Indeterminate progress bars must have an aria-label so screen readers can announce what is loading',
      },
    ],
    related: [
      {
        name: 'Spinner',
        relationship: 'alternative',
        reason: 'Spinner is for unbounded waits; Progress is for operations with a known end point',
      },
      {
        name: 'ProgressBar',
        relationship: 'alternative',
        reason: 'ProgressBar is the richer compound variant with label and percentage display',
      },
    ],
    a11yRationale:
      'Uses the native <progress> element which maps to role="progressbar" automatically; aria-label or aria-labelledby is required for indeterminate state',
    flexibility: [
      {
        area: 'variant',
        level: 'flexible',
        note: 'Choose the variant that matches the semantic meaning of the operation',
      },
      {
        area: 'token names',
        level: 'strict',
        note: 'Colors must resolve to --cascivo-* tokens',
      },
    ],
  },
}
